newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee corrects lower, cocoa firm, sugar dul.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee corrects lower, cocoa firm, sugar dul.

text.p: COFFEE - Opens mixed, all positions head lower in correction to weaker NY close. July down $40 at $2,069 at 0904 GMT.
COCOA - Stronger start in line with due, but ranges tight and volume thin. July up three at 1,022 stg, others slightly firmer.
SUGAR - Barely moves in marginally weaker start. August down 40 cents at $318.00.
